title: Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 restock update: the Nintendo Store remains your best bet
text:
Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 restock update: the Nintendo Store remains your best bet 
 Subscribe Sign in News Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 restock update: the Nintendo Store remains your best bet
 Stock has flashed in and out at the Nintendo Store
 Adam Vjestica Oct 30, 2026 3 Share Latest: follow our Zelda Switch 2 restock tracker for live updates 
 (Credit: Nintendo) 🎮 The Zelda 40th anniversary Switch 2 was released on October 29 and flashed in and out of stock at the Nintendo Store
 🚨 Our Zelda Switch 2 restock tracker @mattswider on X will send out an alert as soon as stock appears 
 👀 Walmart was our top pick to have a restock, but a supply chain delay has pushed the date back
 ⌚ In-store midnight launches are being held at GameStop, Best Buy, and Nintendo New York/San Francisco
 Walmart: Zelda Switch 2 console 
 Best Buy: Zelda Switch 2 console 
 GameStop: Zelda Switch 2 console 
 Nintendo: Zelda Switch 2 console 
 🚨 We’re tracking Zelda Switch 2 stock updates. If you’d like to know when more stock arrives, follow Matt Swider on X and turn on notifications. You can also become a free or paid subscriber to The Shortcut to help support our work. 🚨 
 The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 launched yesterday, and it was the Nintendo Store that held the most restocks. The console flashed in and out of stock repeatedly throughout the day as limited units were sold and quickly snapped up. 
 🚨 Want the Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2? Drop your email for restock alerts before it sells out. ⤵️
 Subscribe Many were met with error messages, “sold out” signs, or “couldn’t add the required amount” to their baskets. However, with a little persistence and luck, others were more successful. As it stands, it’s the best place to try to get the Zelda Switch 2, even if the experience can be a little frustrating.
 We were able to add the console to our basket. (Credit: The Shortcut) We’re expecting a similar situation today as our tracker continues to receive restock alerts. However, we’re reluctant to share them all as many have been false flags, but we immediately notified The Shortcut followers once the first restock went live.
 The Shortcut @ theshortcut Zelda Switch 2 is back in stock at the Nintendo Store: nintendo.com Nintendo Switch™ 2 – The Legend of Zelda™ – 40th Anniversary Edition - Nintendo Official Site 4:18 PM · Oct 29, 2026 · 2.09K Views 2 Replies · 2 Likes Amazon was the only other retailer to hold an online restock, though it sold out almost instantly. No more restocks took place, and sadly, the major Walmart restock of the Zelda Switch 2, which we were confident would take place, did not happen because of a supply chain issue.
 Matt Swider (The Shortcut) @ mattswider 🚨 Zelda Switch 2 console at Amazon right now
 amazon.com/dp/B0HJ6F8L6V?… amazon.com Nintendo Switch™ 2 –The Legend of Zelda™ – 40th Anniversary Edition 3:13 PM · Oct 29, 2026 · 76.7K Views 32 Replies · 4 Reposts · 57 Likes The console will now be available to order online at Walmart on November 6 , with Target also offering the same date. 
 Some lucky shoppers could also get the Zelda Switch 2 in-store, with The Shortcut readers sharing their personal accounts of getting the console at Walmart and helping each other out. 
 (Credit: The Shortcut) If you’re willing to travel to your local store, Best Buy and Nintendo are holding in-store events on November 5 (though you’ll need a Warp Pipe Pass for Nintendo’s event ). GameStop is also letting customers pre-order in-store. . 
 We’ll still be tracking every retailer with our exclusive Zelda 40th anniversary Switch 2 restock tracker , which provides up-to-the-second information when the Zelda Switch 2 is in stock. If the console appears – which it might – our followers will still be the first to know. 
 Up next: PS5 Pro restock: it’s available again, but you’re paying more than you should 
 Subscribe Adam Vjestica is The Shortcut’s Senior Editor. Formerly TechRadar’s Gaming Hardware Editor, Adam has also worked at Nintendo of Europe as a Content Marketing Editor, where he helped launch the Nintendo Switch.
